def load_modules_from_path(path):
    """
    Import all modules from the given directory
    """
    import importlib.util
    import os
    import glob

    # Import all modules
    for module_path in glob.glob(os.path.join(path, "*.py")):
        module_name = os.path.basename(module_path)[:-3]
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, module_path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)

def load_modules_from_package(package):
    """
    Import all modules from the given package
    """
    import importlib.util
    import os
    import glob

    # Import all modules
    for module_path in glob.glob(os.path.join(package, "*.py")):
        module_name = os.path.basename(module_path)[:-3]
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, module_path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)


def load_modules_from_packages(packages):
    """
    Import all modules from the given packages
    """
    for package in packages:
        load_modules_from_package(package)
